text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. I saw Daring Heart happily 
chatting with Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Heh! A "Hokkaido Japanese Food Fair". 
Truly the taste of home, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To think we can enjoy... "Sacred 
Salmon Ara Soup" in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It sounds great! Now I'm starting to look 
forward to it too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day, I saw Daring Tact standing 
alone in the dining hall with wide eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Due to a stocking mix-up, the Hokkaido 
Fair has been canceled—or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No. There's no need to worry. Even if I 
can't eat it in the cafeteria, I know the 
taste of home best.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I remember the recipe perfectly, too... 
The taste of my memories will never fade.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Umm. Next period is dance lessons—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Daring Tact went on as usual. 
Just as she said, she didn't seem bothered 
by the fair's cancellation, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! Don't forget tomorrow's 
schedule, okay!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! The ingredients are all 
ready~!" "Isn't this an unusual genre for 
you? It feels so fresh!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... Daring Heart, who had also looked 
forward to the fair, seemed to be planning 
a new event with her friends.
choice_data_list: (I guess they're both good at moving on.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Maybe I'll have pasta for lunch 
today...
choice_data_list: （ふたりとも、切り替え上手なのかな）

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Tact! We're having a party at lunch! 
You come too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eh? ...Me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Of course! And then—there you are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Trainer over there, you too! The 
more the merrier♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! What a sight, a massive pile of 
zangi!" "Fufu. These are delicious too, 
potato dumplings~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heart's friends were already gathered at 
the place we were led to. And laid out 
upon the tables was—a whole feast of 
dishes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? H-Heart-san! Is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Surprise! We tried recreating it all 
together! We wanted to eat the Hokkaido 
Fair food too♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Scallops, octopus, and is that... 
Genghis Khan? It's amazing, all of 
Hokkaido's specialties are lined up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yep, but that's not all! You can't forget 
the sacred main dish!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...! C-Could that be—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ta-daa! —Sacred salmon ara soup!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It might taste a little bit 
different from your hometown's flavor, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If you think of it as the taste of your 
second home... I'd be so happy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., Heart-san! I'm just so full of 
emotion...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. It feels far yet close, and so very 
warm. I'll savor every single bite!
choice_data_list: I'm starting to miss my hometown too.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You know it! I polish my skills every 
single time we throw a cooking party♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then... fill both your belly and your 
heart today! Enjoy a taste of home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we leisurely enjoyed the 
"Hokkaido Fair" handmade by Daring Heart 
and her friends.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Then next time, I'll recreate 
the taste of your hometown♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on, tell me the tastes of your 
memories!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, thinking of my own hometown, I 
thoroughly enjoyed the "Hokkaido Fair" 
handmade by Daring Heart and her friends.
